summary: Flattrade's om order updates: an intraday order open, partly filled and complete, one rejected with the RMS text, and an NFO stop-loss order cancelled.

notes: Flattrade's order updates ride the market data socket as om frames after {"t":"o"}.
The web's default Flattrade order stream is REST order-book polling (issue #1806: one PiConnect session per uid); the om frames are compared with the normaliser its dedicated socket uses.
